title: Theory that Oppenheimer's security hearing was really about UFOs

tellings.quote: the head of the kangaroo court was a guy named Gordon gray who you know who

plain: Michels suggests that the security hearing against J. Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the atomic bomb project, may really have been about UFOs. He offers this theory himself and calls the hearing a 'kangaroo court' whose head was 'a guy named Gordon Gray'. He reads the hearing transcript alongside the MJ-12 documents, papers of disputed origin that describe a secret committee called Majestic 12 said to have handled UFO matters, and he also brings in the mathematician John von Neumann. If he were right, the public fall of a famous scientist would have hidden a fight over UFO secrets.
